This document
outlines the inspection checklist I2, which 
must be carried out on an annually 
bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the above title block. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 18/8/02 for Saker Qoraish Circuit no. 2 at 
First Urban Community 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.

Safety rope with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area must be used,

items:
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety rope with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area must be used,

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 mask and safety harness

Switch on the earthing switch and check mechanical interlocking with the 
 disconnect switch.
Switch off DC source

Suitable tool 
 set

Pieces of 
 clothes and rags

Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)

Safety 
 harness, helmet

Repeat the maintenance procedures 
 that have to be done according to MPIS document no. 
 DS-035-r0

Clean porcelain surface from dust, 
 dirties, deposits ....... etc.

Inspect well the insulators to 
 insure if there is unseen crack, current traces, or alike

Check dis connector contacts for 
 pitting and corrosion

Clean contact pieces and contact 
 fingers and remove the old grease using cleaning liquid (e.g. Gasoline), then 
 grease them with 1 mm - thickness film of suitable grease (such as Termalene 
 grease 64444, or alike grease)

Check earthing switch contacts for 
 pitting and corrosion, if there is a corrosion of material to a depth of more 
 than 0.5 mm, the earthing contacts must be replaced

Clean and grease the earthing 
 switch contacts as you did with disconnect switch

Check motor and gear box of 
 disconnect switch, clean and then grease them, and clean limit switch, relays, 
 contactors, etc ... with video cleaner

Inspect the mechanical interlocking 
 between the earthing switch and disconnect switch

Inspect movement - transmission 
 arms, hinges, and joints for for disconnect switch, and grease it

Clean the blade of earthing switch 
 (that engages with disconnect switch) and then put a thin film of grease on it

Check earthing switch motor, clean 
 and grease the gear box

Inspect marshalling box of the 
 disconnect switch (the marshalling box is common for disconnect switch, 
 earthing switch, circuit breaker) and clean it

Check flexible connection of 
 earthing switches

Check all screwed joints for tight 
 fit
